cross_mappings.name: Copyright infringement
cross_mappings.description: A model might generate content that is similar or identical to existing work protected by copyright or covered by open-source license agreement.

cross_mappings.name: Decision bias
cross_mappings.description: Decision bias occurs when one group is unfairly advantaged over another due to decisions of the model. This might be caused by biases in the data and also amplified as a result of the model's training.

cross_mappings.name: Exposing personal information
cross_mappings.description: When personal identifiable information (PII) or sensitive personal information (SPI) are used in training data, fine-tuning data, seed data for synthetic data generation, or as part of the prompt, models might reveal that data in the generated output. Revealing personal information is a type of data leakage.

cross_mappings.name: Hallucination
cross_mappings.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.

cross_mappings.name: Harmful code generation
cross_mappings.description: Models might generate code that causes harm or unintentionally affects other systems.

cross_mappings.name: Harmful output
cross_mappings.description: A model might generate language that leads to physical harm.  The language might include overtly violent, covertly dangerous, or otherwise indirectly unsafe statements.

cross_mappings.name: Impact on cultural diversity

cross_mappings.name: Impact on the environment
cross_mappings.description: AI, and large generative models in particular, might produce increased carbon emissions and increase water usage for their training and operation.

cross_mappings.name: Inaccessible training data
cross_mappings.description: Without access to the training data, the types of explanations a model can provide are limited and more likely to be incorrect.
